title: What a team’s numbers may be used for, and what they must not

videos.script: Rafa, fifty-four pages. Caio, six. {{number}} In the team's monthly review, that number found a problem. One person was carrying half the pager, because everybody passed him the card code. It led to runbooks, a fairer rota, and a load that is falling. {{team}} In a performance review, the same number says Rafa handles incidents, and Caio does not pull his weight. Neither is true. {{review}} And the next quarter, people stop passing problems on, and stop writing pages down. The number changes. The problem stays. {{stays}} Nineteen lessons taught how to produce a team's numbers. This one is about what they may be used for, and what they must not. It is not a footnote. It is what the rest was for. {{point}}
